_note: 特殊句構未覆蓋 KP 補建：省略 ellipsis（eng.t_adv.special.ellipsis，學測級）。省略＝把從上下文可清楚推知的重複字詞省去，避免重複：She can sing and (she can) dance.。重點：(1) 對等子句可省去重複的主詞/動詞；(2) 助動詞後可省去重複的主要動詞：I haven't finished, but she has. / So do I.；(3) to 之後可省去重複的動詞：I'd love to.；(4) 只能省去可被上下文「原封不動」還原的字。防第二正解：distractor 只放『文法錯誤』選項（漏 to、助動詞誤用、語序錯），刻意不提供『完整未省略但也合法』的選項，避免兩可。皆標準英語，以 Swan/Oxford，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: 省略（避免重複而省去可推知的字）
units.can_do: 我能用省略把從上下文可清楚推知、重複的字詞省去，讓句子不囉嗦：在對等子句省去重複的主詞/動詞（She can sing and dance.）、在助動詞後省去重複的主要動詞（I haven't finished, but she has.）、在 to 之後省去重複的動詞（I'd love to.）；也知道只能省去能被上下文原封不動還原的字。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Ellipsis means leaving out words that the listener can easily understand from the context, to avoid repetition: 'Lucy can play the piano and (play) the violin.'
claims.verification_ref: 省略＝省去上下文可清楚推知的重複字詞以避免重複；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After an auxiliary (or 'be'), the repeated main verb can be left out: 'I haven't finished, but she has (finished)'; in the so/neither pattern the auxiliary carries the meaning: 'So do I.'
claims.verification_ref: 助動詞（或 be）後可省去重複的主要動詞；so/neither 句由助動詞承載（So do I）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After 'to', the repeated verb can be dropped, but 'to' is kept: 'Do you want to come?' - 'I'd love to.' (= love to come), not 'I'd love.'
claims.verification_ref: to 之後可省去重複動詞，但須保留 to；I'd love to（×I'd love）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: You can only leave out words that can be recovered exactly from the context, and you must keep the right auxiliary: for 'likes' use 'do' ('So do I'), not 'am' or 'like'.
claims.verification_ref: 只能省去可原封不動還原的字、且須留正確助動詞（likes→do，非 am/like）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Ellipsis means leaving out words that the listener can easily understand from the context, so the sentence is not repetitive. In two joined clauses you can drop the repeated subject or verb: Lucy can play the piano and the violin.
teach.zh_hint: 省略就是把聽者從上下文能輕易推知的字省去，讓句子不囉嗦。在兩個相連的子句裡，可省去重複的主詞或動詞：Lucy can play the piano and the violin.（露西會彈鋼琴和拉小提琴。）

teach.body: She wanted to help, and so did her friends.
teach.zh_hint: 她想幫忙，她的朋友們也是。so did her friends 中，did 代替了重複的 wanted to help。

teach.body: After an auxiliary (can, have, do, will) or 'be', you can leave out the repeated main verb: I haven't finished, but she has (finished). In the so/neither pattern the auxiliary carries the meaning: John likes jazz. So do I.
teach.zh_hint: 在助動詞（can、have、do、will）或 be 之後，可省去重複的主要動詞：I haven't finished, but she has（finished）。在 so／neither 句型中，由助動詞承載意思：John likes jazz. So do I.（約翰喜歡爵士樂，我也是。）

teach.body: My brother can drive, but I can't yet.
teach.zh_hint: 我哥哥會開車，但我還不會。can't 後省去重複的 drive（I can't drive yet）。

teach.body: After 'to', you can drop the repeated verb but keep 'to': 'Would you like to join us?' - 'I'd love to.' (= love to join). Do not drop the 'to', and do not keep the whole verb again.
teach.zh_hint: 在 to 之後可以省去重複的動詞，但要保留 to：Would you like to join us?（你想加入我們嗎？）— I'd love to.（我很樂意。＝love to join）。不要把 to 也省掉，也不必再重複整個動詞。

teach.body: I don't exercise every day, but I'd like to.
teach.zh_hint: 我不是每天運動，但我想要（每天運動）。to 之後省去 exercise every day，保留 to。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句是 Lucy can play the piano and Lucy can play the violin 最自然、不重複的說法？
practice.answer: Lucy can play the piano and the violin.
options: Lucy can play the piano and the violin.
Lucy can play the piano and can the violin.
Lucy the piano and the violin.
Lucy can play the piano and play can the violin.

distractor_rationales.Lucy can play the piano and can the viol: 留了 can 卻漏了 play，變成 ×and can the violin；要嘛整組省去、要嘛完整，不能只留助動詞沒動詞。
把動詞 can play 也省掉，句子失去述語，不成句。
distractor_rationales.Lucy can play the piano and play can the: play can 語序顛倒，不成句。

practice.feedback: 對等子句省去重複的 can play：Lucy can play the piano and the violin.

practice.stem: John likes jazz. 你想說「我也是」的簡短句：So ____ I.

distractor_rationales.do like: so 句中助動詞已承載意思，不再重複主要動詞；×So do like I。
distractor_rationales.am: likes 是一般動詞，呼應的助動詞是 do，不是 be 動詞 am。
distractor_rationales.like: so 句型是 So ＋ 助動詞 ＋ 主詞；×So like I 缺助動詞又語序錯。

practice.feedback: 一般動詞 likes 用 do 呼應、動詞省去：So do I.

practice.stem: Would you like to join us? 選出省去重複動詞、最自然的回答：

省去動詞時要保留 to；漏了 to 就不成立（×I'd love）。
語序錯；應是 love to，不是 to love。
to 後面不再加受詞 it；省略式就停在 to：I'd love to.

practice.feedback: to 之後省去 join us、保留 to：I'd love to.

practice.stem: 不重複 swim，完成句子：My sister can swim, but I ____.

distractor_rationales.don't: 原句用助動詞 can，呼應要用 can't，不是 don't。
distractor_rationales.amn't: 英語沒有 amn't 這個字，而且 swim 的助動詞是 can 不是 be。
distractor_rationales.not: 缺助動詞；×but I not。要用 can't。

practice.feedback: 助動詞後省去重複的 swim、留正確助動詞：but I can't.

practice.stem: Have you seen my keys? 選出省去 seen your keys、正確的簡短回答：

問句用助動詞 have，簡短回答要呼應 have，不是 do。
完成式的助動詞是 have，不是 be 動詞 am。
缺助動詞 have；×I seen 不成句。

practice.feedback: 助動詞 have 呼應問句、主要動詞省去：Yes, I have.

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀＋語調模仿：看句子朗讀→自評（不自動判讀發音）。省略處（助動詞、to）語調略停頓，呼應的助動詞稍加重，句尾下收。

lines.text: I haven't finished my report, but she has.
lines.intonation: 逗號略停、句尾 has 稍加重並下收（承載省去的 finished）

lines.text: I don't go jogging every morning, but I'd like to.
lines.intonation: 逗號略停、句尾 to 稍加重並下收（承載省去的 go jogging）
